# vastdata_vast_db_vips (Data Source)

Datasource for retrieving VastDB VIPs

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_vast_db_vips" "vastdb_vast_db_vips" {
  tenant_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (Number) Tenant id

### Read-Only

- `vips` (Attributes List) List of VastDB VIPs (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vips))

<a id="nestedatt--vips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vips`

Read-Only:

- `port` (Number) Port number
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the tenant
- `vip` (String) VIP address
